title: doctor's routing check cannot refuse a runner the run's executors cannot launch
description:
reconcile.CheckRouting (internal/reconcile/profiles.go:758) resolves every role profile against the roles table but never runs usableProfile over them — routeOnDemandJob skips the executor check when executors is nil, and the base profiles get no check at all — so ticfac doctor's 'routing' check (internal/cli/doctor.go:400) blessed a --runner pi repository's review/closeout cells that the run's construction refused on the herdr substrate (the exact defect tick jiv fixes on the writer side). The run still refuses fail-closed at construction, so nothing dispatches wrongly; doctor under-reports what this machine's runs will refuse. A tick could give CheckRouting the honoured-executor set (or let doctor pass knownExecutors() through a CheckRouting variant) so the pre-flight names the same refusals the run does.
evidence: internal/reconcile/profiles.go:758 (CheckRouting, no usableProfile over base profiles); internal/cli/doctor.go:400 (doctor's routingCheck calls it); contrast internal/reconcile/reconcile.go New's construction loop, which runs usableProfile over every role
